# Evan Cohen

> Evan Cohen is Director of Product, AI Platform at Trase. Product leader with 10+ years translating emerging AI research into transformative products. Based in Seattle, WA.

## Professional

- Currently: Director of Product, AI Platform at [Trase](https://trase.ai) (2025–present)
- Previously: Director of Product at [UiPath](https://uipath.com) (2019–2025) — led UiPath Apps, Data Service, Action Center from zero to 1M+ enterprise users
- Previously: AI Product Manager II at [Microsoft](https://microsoft.com) (2015–2018) — AI & Research Group, Ambient Computing & Robotics, Business AI

## Education

- BS Informatics, University of Washington Information School (iSchool), 2014

## Patents

- [US9696967B2](https://patents.google.com/patent/US9696967B2): Generation of an Application from Data
- [US20170131974A1](https://patents.google.com/patent/US20170131974A1): Generation of an Application from Template
- [US11120212B2](https://patents.google.com/patent/US11120212B2): Creating and modifying applications from a mobile device
- [US20210263754A1](https://patents.google.com/patent/US20210263754A1): Robot browser embedding
- [US11494203B2](https://patents.google.com/patent/US11494203B2): Application integration for robotic process automation

## Open Source

- [Smart Mirror](https://github.com/evancohen/smart-mirror): Voice-controlled smart mirror, 2.8k stars, featured in Business Insider
- [Sonus](https://github.com/evancohen/sonus): Speech recognition library with offline hotword detection, 640 stars
